scenarios.name: Hide and restore Tutorials from Show Panels

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible
the Tutorials panel is visible after Team Web
the user opens Show Panels from the Tools tab context menu
the Tutorials panel disappears from the Tools ribbon
the other visible Tools panels remain available
the Tutorials panel reappears after Team Web
Show Panels marks Tutorials as visible
